providers.name: Etsy
providers.nextStep: Create an Etsy developer app, configure OAuth callback handling, and store credentials outside the repo.
approvalRules: Human approval is required before creating or editing any Etsy listing.
Human approval is required before publishing a draft listing.
Agents may prepare local listing copy, tags, and pricing assumptions without external API calls.

providers.name: Printify
providers.nextStep: Create a restricted Printify API token, map preferred providers, and keep product creation in draft-only mode.
approvalRules: Human approval is required before creating any Printify product.
Human approval is required before linking a Printify product to a marketplace listing.
Agents may research catalog options and estimate costs locally.

guardrails: No external commerce API write actions run until credentials, approval rules, and dry-run logging are configured.
Agents can research trends, draft products, estimate costs, and prepare listing copy locally.
Any action that publishes, spends money, changes a shop, or contacts a customer requires explicit human approval.

setupChecklist.label: Credential storage
setupChecklist.notes: Decide where Etsy OAuth secrets and Printify tokens live. Do not commit secrets.

setupChecklist.label: Approval ledger
setupChecklist.notes: Persist who approved each external action, when, and exactly what payload was approved.

setupChecklist.label: Dry-run sync
setupChecklist.notes: Log intended Etsy and Printify payloads locally before enabling real API writes.
